table: SM-1500-C001是兼容12V串口总线舵机，采用粉末冶金外壳、铁芯电机、金属齿牙箱、飞特自主研发的RS485控制板，12位高精度磁编码传感器，D型输出头。堵转扭矩180kg.cm，能实现360度任意角度可控，连续转等工作模式，可实现一键设定中位功能，加速度缓启动与缓停止，能反馈位置、速度、电流、电压、温度、负载参数，从而实现过载和过流保护。适合应用在对扭力要求大，使用频率低的应用场景。 SM-1500-C001 is compatible 12V serial port smart bus servo，using powder metallurgy shell、core motor、metal gearbox、Feetech self researched and developed RS485 control board，12 bit high precision magnetic coding sensor，D shape output shaft. The stall torque is 180kg.cm，it can realize the function of setting the middle point with one key，acceleration slow start and slow stop，can feedback position、speed、voltage、current、temperature、load parameters，thus, overload and over-current protection can be realized. It is suitable for the application scenarios with high torque requirement and low frequency.
